title: Blush
subtitle: A radiant that keeps its blush, framed to make the colour deeper.

stone.origin: Blush color in a diamond is one of the rarest natural phenomena in fine jewelry — a trace of nitrogen arranged just so, sustained through millions of years of pressure. The radiant cut holds that color more completely than almost any other form, concentrating warmth into a single focal point. The starburst frame of white diamonds around the perimeter was designed to amplify the blush at center by contrast, not compete with it.

description: Blush colour in a diamond is among the rarest things in nature — a trace of the right element, arranged just so and held through millions of years of pressure. The radiant cut keeps that colour more completely than almost any other form, concentrating the warmth into a single focal point. Around it, a starburst of white diamonds was set not to compete but to deepen the blush by contrast, framing the centre so its colour reads at full strength. Carried in rose gold, at the throat.
